maya_sales: Claire at OrchardCorp wants a 90-day POC: websocket streaming + function/tool calls that must return strict JSON (per-tenant). They also asked for SAML SSO, BYOK KMS, a 1-page infra runbook for ephemeral tokens, and a pricing ballpark for ~5M tokens/day (peaks ~50 rps). Any blockers?
claire_cust: yes please include a Node SDK snippet we can paste into staging and instructions for rotating creds automatically. Low ops preferred.
rahul_se: Plan: demo on Hosted for speed; propose Dedicated if they need isolation/SLA. Checklist: 1) JSON schemas for functions; 2) SAML IdP metadata; 3) BYOK plan; 4) p95 latency target; 5) residency constraints.
rahul_se: Node SDK snippet (minimal):```js
const rw = require('redwood-sdk')({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const ws = rw.stream({ model:'redwood-chat-1', structured_output:true, schema: {/* JSON schema */} });
ws.send({ input:'Get orders tenant=5', functions:[{ name:'get_orders', schema:{ type:'object' } }] });
ws.on('message', ev => { if(ev.type==='function_call') { const res = getOrders(ev.args); ws.send({ function_response: res }); } });
```
jena_prod: Security quick answers: TLS1.3 in transit, AES-256 at rest, BYOK supported for Private/Dedicated, audit logs available. I'll attach SOC2 summary link in the playbook.
owen_infra: Handshake/runbook highlights: issue ephemeral token TTL=1h from auth bridge, rotate by reconnect (~45m), avoid mid-stream swaps. Minimal curl example: `curl -X POST https://auth.example/ephemeral -d '{"svc":"orchard-poc"}' | jq -r .token` then `wscat -c "wss://stream.redwood.ai/v1?token=<EPHEM>"`. Recommend background token refresh + graceful drain.
sec_bot: Security questionnaire uploaded: https://redwood.internal/sq/orchard-1742006789 (sales+sec) :lock:
demo_bot: Demo env provisioned: demo-orchard-1742006789  creds to be DM'd.
maya_sales: Actions: Rahul send Node SDK + small schema test by EOD; Jena attach security artifacts; Owen publish 1-pager runbook; Sales collect SAML metadata and schedule 90m demo next Wed 10am PT. Claire, can you confirm?
claire_cust: Wed 10am PT works. Sending SAML metadata and BYOK intent now. Thanks team :party_parrot:
